nodes.description: Public mapping of token balances keyed by address; written directly without SafeMath in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount used by transferFrom and approve.
Total token supply set in the constructor from the supplied _supply.
Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates all administrative functions.
Whitelist mapping address=>bool toggled by _mints; bypasses the ensure() sale condition.
Mapping counting sales per address, incremented on every transferFrom and read by condition().
Maximum number of sales per address configured through init().
Minimum transfer amount configured through init(), scaled by decimals.
Maximum transfer amount configured through init(), scaled by decimals.
Whitelisted trading address set by the owner via setTradeAddress and honoured by ensure().
Constant token decimals (18) used for scaling mint/init amounts.
Constant Uniswap router address hardcoded and compared against inside ensure().
Public transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal sale guard; grants transfer if sender/recipient matches owner, router, tradeAddress or whitelist, otherwise applies condition().
Public payable transferFrom with inline allowance handling, unchecked balance updates and no SafeMath.
Public payable approve that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view validating sale count, min sale and max sale limits.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall gateway: a.delegatecall(b) executes attacker-supplied code in the token context.
Privileged mint/whitelist function callable by owner or a hardcoded address; sets balances and canSale.
Owner-only function setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only airdrop loop that computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation using a hardcoded init code hash.
Payable constructor assigning name/symbol/supply, owner = msg.sender and an unlimited router allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance checks and owner assignment.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executed with attacker-controlled target and payload under owner privilege.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom are raw unchecked arithmetic.
total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend can overflow without SafeMath.
Sender address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, forwarded to ensure/condition and used in raw balance math.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Amount parameter of approve.
Target address parameter of delegate, used as delegatecall destination.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate, used as delegatecall payload.
Recipient parameter of _mints whose balance is overwritten.
Mint amount parameter of _mints, multiplied by 10**decimals.
Sale count parameter of init.
Min sale token parameter of init.
Max sale token parameter of init.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Loop index of the batchSend for-loop.
Per-iteration recipient extracted from _tos in batchSend.
Locally computed pair address in ensure, compared against _from.

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal owner before the arbitrary delegatecall is reached.
msg.sender is checked against owner or a hardcoded privileged address in _mints.
msg.sender must be owner to configure sale parameters in init.
msg.sender must be owner to change tradeAddress.
msg.sender must be owner to run batchSend.
msg.sender is used as the spender when checking allowance in transferFrom.
transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
approve writes allowance for msg.sender.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure falls back to condition(_from,_value) when no whitelist matches.
transferFrom performs raw balanceOf subtraction/addition without SafeMath.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length unchecked.
ensure reads tradeAddress to decide whitelist bypass.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to decide whitelist bypass.
ensure compares _from/_to against owner.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the token pair address.
ensure compares _from against the hardcoded UNI router constant.
ensure computes local _UNI from pairFor and compares it to _from.
condition reads _saleNum to bound sales per address.
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer value.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and rewrites balanceOf entries.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*10**decimals.
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true.
_mints scales the minted amount by decimals.
init sets _minSale from token*10**decimals.
init sets _maxSale from maxToken*10**decimals.
init sets _saleNum.
init uses decimals for scaling.
batchSend subtracts from and adds to balanceOf.
batchSend stores the computed total in the local variable.
batchSend drives the loop index i.
batchSend indexes _tos into the local recipient _to.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply*10**decimals.
constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
constructor scales the supplied amount by decimals.
owner is derived directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
delegate executes owner-controlled a.delegatecall(b), granting arbitrary storage mutation.
_from parameter drives the source account in transferFrom.
_to parameter drives the recipient account in transferFrom.
_value parameter feeds the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
_value parameter is the allowance amount written by approve.
parameter a is the attacker-controlled delegatecall target.
parameter b is the attacker-controlled delegatecall payload.
parameter spender selects which balance is overwritten by _mints.
parameter addedValue is the minted amount in _mints.
parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init.
parameter token is scaled into _minSale by init.
parameter maxToken is scaled into _maxSale by init.
parameter _tos is the recipient array of batchSend.
parameter _value is multiplied by _tos.length unchecked in batchSend.
parameter addr is stored into tradeAddress.
_value is forwarded from transferFrom into ensure and then condition.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter only exists to supply the source account of transferFrom, so it collapses into that function.
The _to parameter only exists to supply the recipient of transferFrom, so it collapses into that function.
_value directly drives the raw balanceOf subtraction/addition performed inside transferFrom.
The _spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
The _value parameter is only used as the allowance amount inside approve.
Parameter a is the direct target operand of the dangerous delegatecall.
Parameter b is the direct payload operand of the dangerous delegatecall.
The spender parameter is only used as the balanceOf/canSale key inside _mints.
The addedValue parameter is only used to overwrite balanceOf[spender] inside _mints.
The saleNum parameter is only stored into _saleNum by init.
The token parameter is only scaled into _minSale by init.
The maxToken parameter is only scaled into _maxSale by init.
The _tos array is only iterated by batchSend.
The _value parameter is the multiplicand of the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation.
The addr parameter is only assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
The total local variable holds the unguarded multiplication result and should be folded into that operation.
The loop index i is a purely local artifact of the batchSend loop.
The _to local variable is a purely local per-iteration alias of an element of _tos.
The _UNI local variable is only computed and compared inside ensure.
